info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Employee Assignment Management API allows businesses to update the assignment details of employees within the Human Resource Management system. This API provides endpoints to modify existing employee assignments based on specific parameters, facilitating adjustments such as role changes or department transfers. Typical consumers include HR personnel and payroll systems that need to maintain up-to-date employee information. The API streamlines operations and ensures accurate assignment tracking across the organization.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific employee assignment using their unique ID. Ensure to pass the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request body for a successful operation.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for updating the assignment information of the employee with the ID EMP-900045. The contents should include the specific changes to be made to the employee's assignment details.

200.description: The employee assignment was successfully updated.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a JSON Web Token (JWT) for bearer authentication. When using this scheme, the token must be included in the Authorization header of the request as follows: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token should be a valid JWT, which is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties.
